assumptions: Fixed finite simple bouquets of t >= 2 cycles, lengths >= 3, one common hub; valid orientations have positive indegree at every vertex.
scientific_integrity: Closed symbolic proof and finite independently enumerated checks. No external certification or authorship attribution is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not include general cactus graphs, non-valid orientations, minimum-set multiplicity, or unlabeled orientation orbits. Earlier work covers the one-petal cycle boundary and the upper scalar endpoint for two-petal bouquets. Absolute novelty is not independently established.
title: Orientable total-domination spectrum of cycle bouquets
